instruction: For each rule below, declare where it is verified. Use ONLY names from `evidence`. Omit a rule entirely rather than guess - an unresolvable trace is worse than none, because it reports as covered while nothing verifies the rule. Return JSON: { "proposals": [ { "id": "BR-...", "traces": { "ui": [], "api": [], "db": [], "tests": [] } } ] }

rules.text:
- id: BR-REC-023
    statement: Recon Main tab must render the required column headers with editability behavior exactly as defined in the table column contract.
    priority: Critical

- id: BR-REC-001
    statement: Recon Main tab displays a loan work queue with row-level update controls for operational triage.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-003
    statement: Editable row fields are limited to Driveable, Action, Follow-up Date, and Notes.
    priority: Critical

- id: BR-REC-004
    statement: Action value must be selected from the supported list only.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-005
    statement: Red row highlighting indicates Age 45+ Days from Secured Date and must remain consistent after updates.
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-REC-006
    statement: Bulk Action menu must expose only Follow-up Date, Action, and Notes options (in that order). The Bulk Actions button is disabled when no rows are selected.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-007
    statement: Bulk Notes Add action remains disabled until notes text is provided.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-008
    statement: Bulk Follow-up Add action remains disabled until a valid date is selected.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-011
    statement: PTP Date is displayed as a dedicated table column in Recon Main tab.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-014
    statement: When email is sent to auction, an email icon is shown on the left side of the loan row.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-022
    statement: Export CSV button exports Recon table data when clicked.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-025
    statement: "The Email Auction modal (opened from the row three-dot/kebab menu) presents a Purpose dropdown with exactly these values in this display order: Presale Inspection, Mech/Frame Check, Diag, Repair Update, Estimate, CR Update (see email_use_cases Email Auction purpose_dropdown)."
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-026
    statement: In the Email Auction modal the To field is auto-populated with the Auction Email Address (the auction's fleet-lease/commercial contact(s)) when auction contact information exists, and the CC field defaults to remarketing@firsthelp.com and transports@firsthelpfinancial.com.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-027
    statement: In the Email Auction modal the Subject is auto-populated from the selected Purpose and the VIN in the format "<Purpose> [VIN]" (e.g. "Presale Inspection [VIN]") and remains editable by the user.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-028
    statement: In the Email Auction modal the Email Body is auto-populated from the email_template row for the selected Purpose (department=LOSS_MITIGATION, category=RECON, is_Active=1; template IDs 90–95). Content is governed by the live email_template rows rather than hardcoded in this spec. The field remains editable by the user.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-030
    statement: Hovering over the Recon table's Auction column shows the Auction Contact Card for that row's auction.
    priority: Low
    note: Per SERV-12096, added along with the shared Auction Contact Card component.

- id: BR-REC-032
    statement: |
      Marking a Recon record as Complete removes it from the active Recon queue. The record is
      retained in RECON_DASHBOARD_TRACKER (identified by IDRECON_DASHBOARD_TRACKER) and is never
      deleted — it remains accessible for history and audit. See data_population_rules.lifecycle_rules.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-033
    statement: The Three Dot Menu (kebab ⋮) is hidden for users without write access to the Recon sub-module — only users with Recon write access see it and can access Email Titles and Email Auction. Inherited from specs/components/table.component.yaml RL-008.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-034
    statement: The Title Status filter dropdown must display all available Title Status values in alphabetical (A-Z) order.
    priority: Low

- id: BR-REC-035
    statement: When the Driveable column cell displays the value "No", the text is rendered in red. This is a display-only style change — it does not affect filtering, editing, or any functional behavior of the Driveable field.
    priority: Low

- id: BR-REC-037
    statement: |
      Recon is a Tier 2 read-only Events tab consumer — the Add Event control and Remove Event
      option are not shown to Recon users. Event viewing, sub-tab navigation, and notification
      badge are fully available; only write actions (Add Event, Remove Event) are absent.
      All shared Events tab mechanics are inherited from event.component.yaml and tested via
      Tier 1 test cases in test_cases/components/event/ — Recon's own coverage is exactly 3
      cases per event.component.yaml consumer_test_tiers.tier_2_rhs_consumers.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-038
    statement: |
      Notes added to a Recon record via the inline Notes column field (row-level edit) or via the
      Bulk Notes Add modal (bulk action) are stored as manual notes for the corresponding record
      and must appear in the Manual Notes sub-tab of the RHS Notes tab for that record.
      Both entry points produce notes visible in the same Manual Notes sub-tab — there is no
      separate or secondary location for Bulk Notes.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-039
    statement: |
      The Loan Documents tab contains a "Document Repository" shortcut button in the top-right
      corner of the tab. Clicking it opens the document management system (docman) for the
      selected loan/account. The button is always visible regardless of whether any documents
      are listed in the tab.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-040
    statement: |
      The Email History tab displays only emails sent from the Recon module. Emails from other
      modules are excluded — the tab is filtered by the Recon loggedFrom parameter. No emails
      from other dashboards or modules appear regardless of the selected account's history.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-041
    statement: |
      After a successful email send (Email Auction or Email Titles), the sent email appears in
      the Email History tab immediately — no page refresh is required. The new email is listed
      under the Today group with the correct From, Subject, and sent Time.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-042
    statement: |
      IDRECON_DASHBOARD_TRACKER is a versioning key, not a business identifier. Every time a field
      on a Recon record changes, the current row is set to IS_ACTIVE = 0 and a new row is inserted
      with IS_ACTIVE = 1, preserving a full field-change audit trail. IDRECON_DASHBOARD_TRACKER
      uniquely identifies a single version of a record, not a unique loan or repo event.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-044
    statement: |
      The same loan number can have multiple IS_ACTIVE = 1 rows in RECON_DASHBOARD_TRACKER — one
      per REPO_INSTANCE_ID. There is no technical constraint preventing multiple rows from being
      IS_ACTIVE = 1 simultaneously. When this occurs, the loan number appears multiple times on the
      Recon dashboard, each row tied to a different REPO_INSTANCE_ID. The Recon dashboard does not
      deduplicate by loan number; it displays one row per active RECON_DASHBOARD_TRACKER record.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REC-045
    statement: |
      The Recon dashboard loads with a default sort of Follow-up Date ASC (primary) then
      Date Added ASC (secondary). Rows with no Follow-up Date set (NULL) appear last. Within
      rows that share the same Follow-up Date value, Date Added ASC determines the tie-break
      sequence. This default ordering applies on initial page load and after any filter change
      that triggers a data reload; it is overridden only when the user manually clicks a column
      header sort control.
    priority: High
